_comment: Optional. Merged over ~/.claude/hooks/notify.json for this project only.
Every key is optional; an absent one leaves that behaviour off, so a project
that just wants the notification sounds needs no file at all.
lint          -- run on each written file. {python} = the running interpreter,
{file} = the file just written. Exit non-zero sends it back.
lint_suffixes -- which file suffixes to lint / count as 'code changed'.
verify        -- the whole check. Runs after a turn that changed code, and
before a commit, which is refused while it is red.
guarded_paths -- the first edit to a path containing one of these becomes a
permission prompt; once one goes through, that file is not
prompted again for the rest of the session. For documents
where a misread requirement is expensive.
guarded_text  -- an edit whose payload contains one of these becomes a
permission prompt. For a reserved constant, e.g. a version.
